stories.title: Le CHUV accumule 260 millions de francs de prestations non facturées depuis l'introduction de Tardoc

en.title: CHUV accumulates 260 million francs in unbilled services since Tardoc introduction
en.summary: A Swiss hospital has accumulated 260 million francs in unbilled medical services following the implementation of the new Tardoc billing system on January 1, 2026. The hospital pays interest to the canton while health insurers retain the unclaimed amounts, with normalization expected by early 2027.

en.title: Finma launches enforcement procedure against Haute Capital over market manipulation suspicions

The company's stock has declined nearly 75% since January, with numerous insider transactions by management at the centre of the investigation.
